posts.title: Reflections from TPAC 2026
posts.description: TPAC is W3C's yearly work week. A large part of the Working Groups and all sorts of committees get together to collaborate in person (mostly hybrid). posts.title: AI and greener choices
posts.description: The earth is heating up and AI isn't helping. It drives major increases in electricity use, water use and CO2 emissions. Yet, industry and governments alike seem keen to leverage the latest tech. Can we make greener choices? Yesterday, I spoke at a conference on AI in government about sustainable choices.
